name: Selections of a few objects
definition: When order does not matter, count the ordered versions and then divide by the number of orders you counted each group in. Choosing two people from five gives ten pairs, not twenty, because each pair was counted in both orders.
recognizeWhen: how many ways to choose a team of
pick two of them, order does not matter
how many pairs can be formed
select a committee from the group
misconceptions: I counted the pairs as if order mattered, so I doubled every answer.
I divided by the wrong number when correcting for order.
I used arrangements because the word choose was not in the question.
